title: GTA 6 PC Release Date: Still Not Announced by Rockstar
description: GTA 6 PC release date is still unannounced as the PS5 and Xbox launch lands on November 19. Here is what Rockstar has confirmed and what history suggests.

body.text: The GTA 6 PC release date remains a mystery just days before the game arrives on consoles. According to Yahoo Tech, Rockstar Games has not announced a PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI or given any PC timeline as of November 15, 2026. For PC gamers in India and everywhere else, that means waiting while console players head to Vice City first.
GTA 6 PC release date: what Rockstar has confirmed

The console launch is set for Thursday, November 19, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Yahoo Tech reports that the game returns to Vice City, the Miami-inspired setting from earlier games in the series.
The story follows two lead characters, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, who get pulled into a criminal conspiracy across the fictional state of Leonida.

On the platform question, the official GTA 6 website lists only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar's parent company, named the same two platforms in its November 9 earnings report and made no mention of PC, according to the article.
Will GTA 6 come to PC later? What history says
Not being announced is not the same as never happening. Yahoo Tech points out that Rockstar has often put big games on consoles first and brought them to computers afterwards.

items: Grand Theft Auto V launched on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in September 2013, then reached PC in April 2015, about 19 months later.
Red Dead Redemption 2 hit consoles in October 2018, and its PC version followed in November 2019, just over a year after.
Fans have speculated about a 2027 PC release, but Rockstar has not announced any 2027 window or a date for when it might reveal one.

body.text: These past gaps suggest a later PC launch is possible. They do not prove when, or even whether, GTA 6 will come to computers.
Can you pre-order GTA 6 on PC?
No. Per Yahoo Tech, pre-orders exist only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no official PC pre-order, no Steam release date and no published PC system requirements.
Rockstar also has not said where a PC edition would be sold. Steam, the Epic Games Store and the Rockstar Games Launcher are all open questions at this point.

Keep an eye on Rockstar's official website and any post-launch announcements from the studio or Take-Two. Anything about a PC version, pre-orders or system requirements would have to come from there. Until then, treat 2027 PC dates you see online as speculation, not confirmed fact. We will update this story if Rockstar says anything official.

faqs.a: Rockstar Games has not officially announced a PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI, according to Yahoo Tech. As of November 15, 2026, only PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S are confirmed.

faqs.q: When does GTA 6 launch on consoles?
faqs.a: GTA 6 launches on Thursday, November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, per Yahoo Tech's report.

faqs.q: Can you pre-order GTA 6 on PC?
faqs.a: No. According to Yahoo Tech, pre-orders are open only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and there is no announced PC pre-order, Steam date or system requirements.
